content:
Ravi: starting quick health-check for Tom's Priv deploy (tenant: HelixCare). Focus: connectivity (IPSec/WireGuard), IAM cross-account role, KMS key alias & rotation, audit log path to Splunk, and renewal watch. Anyone seeing blockers?
Lena: FYI their network team prefers IPSec with NAT-T. We'll need UDP 500/4500 open in both directions and allow ESP. Also ask them to check MTU (we hit fragmentation on 1500 -> recommend 1420).
Tom (Customer): confirmed IPSec preference. I'll request the firewall change; their ops window is tonight 0200-0300 UTC.
Carlos: On IAM, cross-account role must be named exactly `RedwoodPrivateAssumeRole` and trust policy should include our account 210987654321. Common pitfall: adding a `Condition` that blocks STS AssumeRole from outside their org — don't add that.
Marta: KMS: we require an alias starting with `alias/redwood/` and key policy must grant `kms:Decrypt` to `arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/redwood-priv-svc`. If they plan automatic rotation, note we only support rotation enabled at key-level, not external KMS.
Tom (Customer): can you paste the minimal key alias/attach step?
Marta: minimal cli snippet:
```
aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/redwood/helixcare --target-key-id <key-id>
aws kms put-key-policy --key-id <key-id> --policy file://redwood-kms-policy.json
```
Make sure the policy includes the role ARN above.
Lena: Observability: audit logs go to Splunk index `privnet_audits` (not `redwood_priv_audit` for this tenant). We forward JSON events; confirm their Splunk team whitelisted our collector IPs.
Tom (Customer): Splunk team asked for the collector IPs list. Where's that published?
Ravi: added link to infra IP list in the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/privnet-ips#helixcare. I'll DM the exact CIDR.
onboard-bot: onboarding-check: network(pending), iam(ok), kms(pending), audit(forwarding pending). See https://redwood.internal/onboard/3310004321/status
Carlos: small security note: enable CloudTrail multi-region + log file validation. If they have S3 Object Lock enabled it can break our processing pipeline; we prefer no Object Lock on the ingestion bucket.
Tom (Customer): I'll check Object Lock and share the bucket name.
Marta: Also capture rotation window: if key rotation is scheduled, let us know a 24h heads-up so we can coordinate agent restarts.
Ravi: Action items: 1) Tom open firewall for UDP500/4500 + ESP, MTU to 1420 (Tom) 2) Create alias `alias/redwood/helixcare` and attach KMS policy (Tom + Marta) 3) Confirm cross-account role name `RedwoodPrivateAssumeRole` (Tom) 4) Splunk collector IPs added and index `privnet_audits` confirmed (Tom + Lena) 5) Post final bucket name and CloudTrail settings (Tom).
billing-bot: renewal-alert: account shows 3x usage forecast spike; recommend watchlist. If onboarding blocked >48h tag account `renewal-risk` to alert AMs.
Ravi: noted — we'll track time-to-ready. If network stays pending past their ops window we'll escalate to AM and solutions.
Lena: quick doc fix: updating quickstart to list required network ports (IPSec: 500/4500, WireGuard: 51820 if used, control-plane 8443) and MTU note. Will push PR.
Tom (Customer): thanks all, I'll update here after the firewall window tonight. :raised_hands:
